description: Coast Conservation & Coastal Management Department - Notify the 'Panama Sand Dune Belt' as an 'affected area' for the purposes of Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Act
reasoning: This gazette content involves the declaration of an "affected area" under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act, No. 57 of 1981. It constitutes a regulatory action where the President exercises powers vested by specific legislation to make a legal declaration. The content focuses on establishing a legal framework for coastal resource management rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves the implementation and application of existing legislation through statutory instruments.
